list: The official 55 trophies, frozen 2026-11-18: names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, via Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guides are this entry's own words; each names its sources. Two methods are still unconfirmed and say so honestly.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. No online play and no DLC are needed: the whole list is single-player. Save it for last — it is the reward for finishing everything else in this guide, and the final mission, the 100% checklist and the last cleanup trophies are the three things standing between you and it.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks while you play the opening hour; you cannot miss it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. The chapter ends after the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, so keep playing the story and this pops on its own.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. It unlocks after the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City — just follow the story.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. It unlocks after the final mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. This is the gold trophy for completing the campaign, so it pops at the end of the story; free-roam stays open afterwards, so every cleanup trophy can still be earned after the credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It unlocks during the mission itself — play the story and it comes automatically.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. A story trophy: it pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. A story trophy: finish the mission and it unlocks.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. A story trophy: finish the mission and it unlocks.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. A story trophy: finish the mission and it unlocks.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. A story trophy: finish the mission and it unlocks.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), which opens after the story. It is far kinder than it sounds: PowerPyx puts it near 60% true completion. Most side quests are not required, collectibles count only partly — scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles and study 100 of 255 animals through the binoculars — and you need any 70 of the 80 challenges. The only tasks that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts. PowerPyx counts 397 in total: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix the four kinds freely; the under-bridge flights are the quickest. Track them by region in Progress, Activities, Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist later wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count in Touchpad, Progress, Activities. Most are introduced by the story or marked with blue dumbbell icons on the map, and you will tick most of them off while chasing the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 range locations. PowerPyx links a full location guide for all 42 gold medals; the medals are not very hard, and they also feed the 100% checklist, which needs every range done.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations (42 races in total). Each location has its own race; win one at each and the trophy pops. The 100% checklist needs all drone races, so this is not a detour.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations, and a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race all count. Work through the race icons on the map; wins at new locations stack towards the 20.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him at it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. There are 4 video games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home (interact with the controllers; available from Chapter 1), and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. Finishing all levels of any one of them once is enough — you do not need every challenge.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline — Lucia only. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3; while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. Complete her 5 quests (Climbing the Cellerichain parts 1 to 3, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass). Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's optional questline. It is marked in Chapter 1; after the mission Island Dreams he calls you and is marked with the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests with the metal detector on the ocean floor and bring them back. Kenton goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2 to 3 (playing as Jason, call Brian to speed it up), so the trophy is not missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline. It is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his 5 quests (Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes). All of it stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — PowerPyx confirms Kirk (the Skunk Ape and Mr. Mangrove quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries) among them, and notes more strangers are still being found. Optional questlines such as Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count. Track your count in the trophy list; everything is still there after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Granforma Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon); the cars he marks appear on the map, and scanning a car with the WAiNK app tells you if it is on the list. Deliver them in good condition for more money. It can all be done after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline — Jason only. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers for Synthetic Labs appear in Vice City. Destroy the labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, which unlocks the trophy. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_reason: The first meditation happens only in Chapter 1 at Jason's house and becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1 (PowerPyx). Do it before finishing Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots at 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts twice, and you can track them in Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: the first meditation happens only in Chapter 1 at Jason's house. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept; she teaches you to meditate. That one is not marked as a Meditation Spot, and PowerPyx notes it is still unclear whether it is required for the trophy — do it anyway, while you still can. The last spot needs both characters together, unlocked after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — while playing as Jason you get a text marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County (Jason only). He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 and marks hunting spots on the map; bring the animals you hunt back to him. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy, so work through Bret's quests and the 15 Target Decks (needed for 100% anyway).

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of the 18 sets in the game. PowerPyx links all 18 set locations; you only need any 3, so pick the sets whose cards sit closest together and clear those first.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1 to scan). There are far more than 100: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Scan whatever you pass — any 100 count.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 in total and the 100% checklist wants any 70, so this trophy falls out naturally on the way — pick the easiest ones left and track them under Progress, Challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Available after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when you can free-roam with Jason and Lucia together — call your partner with Right plus Triangle. Get to 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the easy route, as police struggle on the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you. It also pops naturally while robbing the large bank vaults, which always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Call your partner, then hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) while staying wanted — keep the flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring an armoured vest, sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline. The 3 jewellery stores in north Vice City work well (available after Yasmani's Jewellery Jobs in Chapter 3); rob a couple of items in each, break the safe in the back room, and if the trophy has not popped after the third shop, hit a fourth — the pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan vehicles as they pass — just stand by a busy road. Scanning is enough; you do not need to drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist wants 200 base models scanned, so this comes automatically. Check totals in Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 plus R3 while aiming — time slows and weak spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. Buff focus first with food, drinks or a shower at home, take Adrenaline to stretch it, wear body armour and use an assault rifle such as the Duke 556. Line up 5 gang members at an illegal operation — PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up as you play (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots), so it gets easier later.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal at VCIA and fly away. It must be a plane connected to a boarding bridge — the ones parked on the airfield do not count. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to board, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km from the airport and the trophy pops (slightly delayed).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base — drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and the trophy pops; fire the cannon at the soldiers if it does not pop at once.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewellery store without being detected. First finish Yasmani's Jewellery Jobs (Chapter 3) to unlock the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and to mark jewellery store robberies on the map. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (not the kick, which trips the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which teaches the method: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and rob it — bring your partner to carry a second bag. Afterwards pay Yasmani $10,000 a tip to mark more security vans (finish his Payday Loans jobs first). There are 8 large bank jobs and the 100% checklist wants all 8; robbing a vault instantly gives 4 stars, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch cars to break the heat.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armoured truck and escape. It pops automatically in the same Chapter 4 optional mission, That's Where The Money Is… — tailing the truck to a bank vault counts as the truck robbery. Or do it early: block an armoured truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests).

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the whole map is visible. PowerPyx links a fast unfogging route and plane choice.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, marked with yellow icons when you get near them (many are also marked by the story); you need only one per gang for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39. Track each gang's count in Progress, Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar at the Oceanview Hotel on Ocean Beach — past the pool, up the rooftop elevator — buy the $10 Apple Martini at the rooftop bar and drink it by the railing overlooking the ocean. PowerPyx's updated guide and damnmodz both confirm the spot and the drink, and a gameplay video shows the same steps.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Reported by one written guide so far: after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, go to the Sunrise Autos showroom in the south of Vice City (Southside, near Peacock Bay). Clone the key of the blue Bravado Banshee convertible on display, get in and drive straight through the big glass showroom window — keep driving down the street, as the pop is slightly delayed. PowerPyx reports this method, damnmodz lists it as reported from a single source, and a gameplay video shows the same escape.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations. It opens as the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs (Ammu-Nation) for the safe. The three items: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it open). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item — and you do not need all three in one visit: the robbery icon respawns, so you can come back for what you missed. Not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check Strength in Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, select a character. It needs both characters, so it opens after Coffee Break (Chapter 2). Buy a fitness club membership and always train together — call your partner with Right plus Triangle: while one of you works out, the other trains automatically, so you progress twice as fast. Fitness clubs are filterable on the map under Activities.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. The trophy list itself tracks your count out of 500. Turn on criminal-profile notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile) so you see the demon-face icon whenever an action counts. Stealthy objectives and clean escapes push you towards Professional; knocking enemies down without killing them is Hardened; killing is Violent; mass killing and driving over gravestones is Psycho; keep it up and you hit Irredeemable, which is permanent — avoid that, as police then shoot on sight. Most of the 500 come passively from robberies and fights.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Belum terkonfirmasi — no guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks yet. The official description only says 'Second time's the charm.' PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown and notes only a belief that it may relate to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — that is a guess, not a confirmed method, so this guide does not repeat it as a step. Check back after more players report it; do not waste a run chasing the rumour.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Belum terkonfirmasi — no guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks yet. The official description only asks 'What the hell just happened?' PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, noting only a believed link to a UFO questline. A social video claims a late-night UFO event in Kelly County, but no guide has confirmed it, so this guide does not present it as a method. Treat UFO rumours as unconfirmed until a named guide verifies one.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Reported, not yet confirmed by a second guide: kick 10 pedestrians within 60 seconds while riding a motorbike or bicycle — press Square to kick — on a busy stretch such as Ocean Beach or a crowded Vice City street. That is the method damnmodz reports, reading PowerPyx the same way; PowerPyx itself still lists the trophy as unknown, and another tracker still marks it unconfirmed, so treat the 10-in-60-seconds figure as reported rather than proven. The official hint is 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.'

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in one robbery (unlocked after That's Where The Money Is…), so this comes naturally with the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn through it — the priciest shops. PowerPyx counts 14 mod shops, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores, plus 19 Pay 'n' Sprays. Spending from the story and the other trophies covers most of it.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garage properties (12 garages exist in total; 4 are story-related and do not count). They cost $160,000 together and go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses) — the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone and you buy through it. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 to 4, are the quickest way to raise the money.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). You need enough garages first — each garage adds parking spots — then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Moses only takes vehicles without trackers at first, and registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
